definitions.explanation: woven fabric made from cotton fibers, used for clothing, towels, and various household textiles

examples.japanese: {綿布|めんぷ}で{作|つく}ったシャツは{肌触|はだざわ}りがいい。
examples.english: Shirts made of cotton cloth feel good against the skin.

examples.japanese: この{綿布|めんぷ}は{通気性|つうきせい}に{優|すぐ}れている。
examples.english: This cotton fabric has excellent breathability.

examples.japanese: {明治時代|めいじじだい}に{国産|こくさん}の{綿布|めんぷ}{生産|せいさん}が{急速|きゅうそく}に{拡大|かくだい}し、{輸出品|ゆしゅつひん}としても{重要|じゅうよう}になった。
examples.english: During the Meiji era, domestic cotton fabric production expanded rapidly and became important as an export product.

notes:
Combines {綿|めん} (cotton) and {布|ぷ} (cloth). A somewhat formal or technical term for cotton fabric. In everyday conversation, {木綿|もめん} or simply コットン is more common, but {綿布|めんぷ} appears in product descriptions, historical texts, and textile industry contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {綿布|めんぷ}{製品|せいひん}: cotton fabric products
- {綿布|めんぷ}の{生産|せいさん}: cotton fabric production
- {綿布|めんぷ}を{織|お}る: to weave cotton cloth
- {綿布|めんぷ}の{輸入|ゆにゅう}: cotton fabric imports

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {木綿|もめん}: cotton (fabric) — the everyday term, especially for traditional Japanese cotton
- コットン: cotton — the English loanword, commonly used in modern fashion and products
- {絹布|けんぷ}: silk cloth — the silk equivalent
- {麻布|まふ}: hemp cloth; linen — fabric made from hemp fibers
